# Walking skeleton - one real recipe and shopping list

Outcome: A cook can save one recipe, then a second household member can sign in on a phone, see it, and turn it into a shopping list.

Acceptance: On the deployed product the web app saves one recipe and the signed-in phone shows it; its shopping list ticks off items on both.

Try it:
1. In a browser, open http://localhost:5173/login, sign in as a cook, and save a recipe called "Walking skeleton soup".
2. On the phone, open the recipe. Expect it to show.
3. Make its shopping list. Expect every ingredient on it.
